output.reason: Unilateral painful, swollen, warm calf two days after long-haul flight suggests possible DVT, which needs same-day in-person assessment with compression ultrasound and blood testing that messaging cannot provide.
output.patientMessage: Please get seen in person today (urgent care or emergency department) for an ultrasound of your leg. A painful, swollen, warm calf after a long flight can mean a blood clot, and diagnosis needs imaging that can't be done by message. If you develop chest pain, shortness of breath, coughing up blood, or fainting, call 911 immediately. A Counsel clinician can review and help coordinate in this thread, but don't delay being seen.
